I can't find that Side Chain, automation, quantize, velocity, or MIDI Transform control in my version of Logic.
Reference the exact prior test, preserve what improved, distinguish routing/automation/timing/velocity from loudness, and recommend at most one next step.
Why did that happen, and what should I learn from it?

I can't find that Side Chain, automation, quantize, velocity, or MIDI Transform control in my version of Logic.
Reference the exact prior test, preserve what improved, distinguish routing/automation/timing/velocity from loudness, and recommend at most one next step.
Why did that happen, and what should I learn from it?

Explain the principle in plain language and connect it to the exact A/B: Logic Humanize randomizes position, velocity, and length within ranges; it does not understand groove, accents, phrasing, or instrument role.
